Near the center of this purple structure, there is a darker purple small circular dense area, and a labeling line points to it. Reasoning: The question asks about the part closest to the center in the image. This dark dense small round body located inside the large purple nucleus and closest to the center is called the nucleolus in biological diagrams, so the answer is nucleolus.
